opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search
opportunities.description: Search Kayak for hotels in a destination for given check-in and check-out days, set room and guest counts, then optionally apply filters and sort by price.
steps: Click 'Search for hotels'.
Type the destination into the location textbox and select the matching suggestion.
Click the check-in day, then the check-out day, in the date picker.
Click 'Search' (or the search submit control if no Search button appears).
Open 'Number of rooms and guests', use the Increment buttons (or type a count) to set rooms and guests, then click 'Update'.
Optionally apply filters (star rating, amenities such as free internet, air-conditioned, property style, distance).
Click the 'Price (low to high)' sort tab.

instances.values: destination typed 'Le maraise', selected 'Le Marais, Paris, France'; check-in 27, check-out 2; guests/rooms incremented twice; sorted by Price (low to high) after Distance.
destination 'Santa Fe' selected 'Santa Fe, New Mexico, United States'; check-in 16, check-out 18; guests/rooms incremented twice; submitted via icon click (no filters or sort).

destination 'kashi vishwanath temple' selected 'Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi'; check-in 6, check-out 10; guests incremented three times and count typed as 7; filters 8+ rating, 3 option, free internet, Family style, air-conditioned; sorted Price (low to high). Interrupted by Qatar Airways flight-status search (757.5-770.1) and resumed.
destination 'Los Angeles' selected 'City' option; check-in 21, check-out 23; guest option 4 selected; submitted via icon click.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search (one-way, origin and destination, depart date, passengers and cabin)
opportunities.description: Search Qatar Airways flights for an origin city, destination city, departure date, passenger mix and cabin class, then choose a fare from the results.
steps: Open the flight booking form.
Type the origin city in the 'From' autocomplete and select the suggestion.
Type or choose the destination city in the 'To' field and select it.
Click the depart date field and choose the day in the calendar grid.
Open 'Passengers / Class', adjust infant and child counts, and select the cabin class.
Click 'Confirm', then 'Show flights'.
Click the desired fare heading and then its 'Select fare' button.

instances.values: From 'colombo' (Colombo), To 'new york' (New York); depart 24 June 2023; infant count decreased, child count increased by 1; Business/First; Show flights; selected fares LKR 1,120,521 and then LKR 3,125,932. Interrupted by IGN browsing (481.9-492.3) and resumed.

Destination picked from the Explore page (Africa, Durban) instead of typed; From 'doha' (Doha); depart 28 May 2023; infant count increased by 1; Continue, Confirm, Show flights; selected fare QAR 4,980.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search
opportunities.description: Search Qatar Airways hotels for a destination, check-in and check-out dates, and guest/room counts, sort results by price, and optionally reserve a property.
steps: Click 'Book', then the 'Hotels' link.
Type the destination in the searchbox and select the suggestion.
Pick the check-in date and check-out date (or length of stay) in the calendar.
Click 'Search'.
Set guests and rooms in the guest selector, then click 'Done' or 'See availability'.
Optionally change the sort to price (lowest first).
Click 'Reserve' on a chosen property.
parameters: check-out date or number of nights

instances.values: destination 'Las Vegas Nevada, United States'; check-in 10 April 2023, check-out 16 April 2023; Search; sorted Price (lowest first).

destination 'Washington District of Columbia, United States'; check-in 5 June 2023 after calendar navigation; 1 night; 2 adults, 0 children, 1 room; Search, then guest selector Done, See availability, Reserve. Guest selector was opened after Search here, unlike the first instance.
